cases.claim_scope: CHARACTERIZATION ONLY of the Sheen 1990 stepped-impedance LPF stopband — explicitly NOT an rfx accuracy claim. The Palace-FEM referee showed the stopband is a DOUBLE transmission zero (~7.0 and ~8.0 GHz): openEMS resolves both and matches Palace to ~0.7%; the referee records sides_with=openems. HISTORY: the original num_periods=20 default-offset rfx leg was non-passive (58/120 bins, worst column power 1794.5 at 17.05 GHz) and its argmin (7.218 GHz) sat 9.6% from openEMS. Root cause was MEASURED for the truncation half (settling witness -24.7/-24.3 dB; the probe near-field half is measured in PR #468) and the leg REGENERATED 2026-07-26 with num_periods=60 (witness -72.2/-72.4 dB) + n_probe_offset=30 (satisfies BOTH the 5*h_sub near-field clearance and the lambda_g/4 reflector clearance that offset=40 violated) + passivity-enforced S: strict ||S||_2 <= 1 at every bin (max column power 0.9938), raw excess recorded per bin in passivity_correction (84/120 bins > 0.05, worst 0.365 at 18.03 GHz — the dx=200 um coarse-mesh envelope, bounded and recorded rather than quoted). With decontaminated probes the rfx argmin lands at 7.874 GHz — the ~8 GHz doublet member, 1.4% from openEMS — confirming the referee's doublet structure; sides_with=openems stands (structure distance 1.91% vs openEMS 0.66%). KNOWN RESIDUAL, printed not gated: the fitted passband (0.5-3 GHz) median Re(Z0) reads ~67 ohm vs openEMS's ~51 ohm at offset 30 AND 40 — a low-frequency fit-conditioning artifact, not an offset trade-off; in-band (5-15 GHz) median Re(Z0) is 49.8 ohm. The argmin null POSITION and passband/stopband STRUCTURE are the readable outputs; |S| magnitudes at bins with correction > 0.05 remain artifact-class. Gates lock (A) openEMS reference sanity comparator-first, (B) comparison shape, (C) the committed argmin nulls + rfx passband mean + referee verdict, and (D) the evidence chain: strict bound, settling witness, and the passivity-correction footprint (fail-closed D0 if a leg lacks the witness/enforcement fields).

cases.claim_scope: Deliberately NARROW E2 envelope: the rfx source -> vector-probe -> run -> harminv eigenfrequency pipeline against an EXACT analytic oracle for ONE air-filled PEC cavity (a,b,d) = (50,30,40) mm on a dx = 1 mm mesh chosen as an exact divisor of all three extents, so wall registration contributes zero geometric-quantization error and the residual is pure 2nd-order Yee dispersion. Gated modes: TE101 (fundamental) < 1%, and at least one higher mode of TM110/TE011/TM111/TE201/TM210/TE102 < 2%. Closed lossless PEC is the correct configuration for a cavity, so the energy-based ring-down settling witness DOES NOT APPLY and is not claimed; harminv Q is a window-length artefact, printed but never gated — only the FREQUENCY is claims-bearing. No external solver and no meshing tolerance enter the oracle. This says nothing about open/CPML structures, lossy or dispersive fills, non-uniform meshes, or any other geometry.

GATED: coarse ka <= 1.25 and the fine rung at ka = 2.0 ONLY, at gate = round-up(measured clearance-scan envelope x 1.5) — the envelope population (7-point clearance scan plus three domain realizations) is committed fixture data and the gate test recomputes it, so gate and envelope cannot drift apart. Witnesses committed as data: domain realizations, the clearance scan, and a truncation witness on the gated bins; the effective-radius, #280-incident-leakage and 9.6-rung resolution falsification probes are recorded as offline provenance, not data. Extends (does not replace) the committed E4 ladder and the fine ka~1 fixture; non-FDTD corroboration (Bempp EFIE, ka <= 2) lives in tests/fixtures/rcs_sphere_three_way/ and extending it above ka = 2 is an offline follow-up.
